paragraphs.text: Local-first workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): turns your local AI coding agents into an o
bservable, accountable team - task board, session reader, commit attribution, daily/weekly reports.
Zero runtime deps; data stays on your machine.
# fde-console — Super Workbench
English | 中文文档
A local-first workbench plugin for DSH that turns your local AI coding agents (ZCode, Claude Code, C
odex, OpenCode, DSH, WorkBuddy…) into an **observable, accountable agent team**.
**The core loop: See → Understand → Attribute → Accept.**
- **See** — live agent activity across six local session sources (per-project feed, running-now sect

ion, 28-day heatmap)
- **Understand** — full transcript reader per session, plus the *dispatch promp

t*: the original human instruction behind each session
- **Attribute** — commits and sessions auto-a
ttached to tasks via a branch/markdown convention (docs/ATTRIBUTION.md), with a repo guard against c

ross-repo false matches
- **Accept** — evidence lives on the task: timeline, session evidence with o
ne-click confirm, daily/weekly reports with Markdown export
**Local-first by design:** no cloud, no third-party runtime dependencies (Node built-ins only), all
data in one directory you own. Agent sessions are read-only observed — the workbench never writes in
ectory you own. Agent sessions are read-only observed — the workbench never writes into your agents.
## Features
- **Task board** — kanban with timeline, acceptor sign-off, deep links, priorities, due dates, daily

diary per task
- **Agent observation** — six-source adapters, session lists, transcript reader, run

ning-now detection, per-project tabs
- **Work search** — `Ctrl+K` across task titles, session titles

, commit messages and diaries
- **Dispatch prompts** — see the original instruction each agent sessi

on was started with
- **Session evidence** — suggested attachments scored per task, one-click or bat

ch confirm
- **Reports** — auto-generated daily digest and weekly review, exportable as Markdown
- *

*Heatmap & scorecards** — 28-day activity grid per agent; SVG scorecard endpoints
- **Integrations**
— MCP server (stdio) so your agents can query the board; webhook out; IM notify (Feishu/DingTalk bo

ts); Gitea/GitHub/Gitee activity feeds
- **Governance** — credential never touches disk (git config
runtime read), redaction on every output, SSRF allowlist for all outbound, single-instance lock with
warning, backup/restore
## Requirements

| Node.js | **≥ 22.13** (uses built-in `node:sqlite`) |
| DSH | 0.2.1-rc.2 (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`) |
|
pnpm | on PATH (plugin install forwards to it) |
## Quick start
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Open the printed URL (auth token included) → **Super Workbench** appears in the sidebar. Your local
agents are detected automatically — zero config to see your first session.
Data lives in `<DSH_HOME|~/.dsh>/fde-console/` (`data/` + config). A fresh data directory stores JSO
N; run `node scripts/migrate-storage.js` (with every instance stopped) to move the owned units to SQ
Lite + WAL. JSON remains the export/interop format.
Step-by-step verification (test gate → plugin load → API round-trip → UI): docs/VERIFY.md.
## Demo dataset
Want a populated workbench before connecting anything? Seed a fully synthetic dataset (members, task
s, minutes, inbox candidates, team events — placeholder names only, zero network):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then start the instance and explore; delete the seeded JSON files to reset. The seed goes through th
e JSON storage channel, so it targets fresh (un-migrated) data dirs — the script refuses a migrated
(SQLite) target and asks you to use a new directory.
## The six views
| View | What it shows |

| Overview | stats, agent heatmap, digital-worker reports (daily/weekly), version matrix |
| Task Ra

dar | meeting transcripts → AI task decomposition → inbox gate |
| Task Board | kanban: timeline, ac

ceptor, deep links, diary, project filters |
| Agents | live activity feed across six sources + sess

ion reader |
| Members | desktop agents + human members: status, output, diary nudge |
| Team Activi

ty | multi-source commit/PR feed with task attribution |
| Settings | sources, engine, security allo
wlist, one-click env check |
## Attribution protocol
AI-made commits can self-attach to tasks with three conventions: branch `task/<id>`, marker `[#<id>]
` in the message, or binding the task to a project directory. See docs/ATTRIBUTION.md — includes a r
eady-to-paste snippet for your own `AGENTS.md` and a `commit-msg` hook.
Writing your own session-source adapter (Cursor, Trae, Aider…): see docs/ADAPTERS.md.
